source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Flash System ROM to the previous version with AMI flash tool for uEFI.
1. Send command: afuefix64.efi <BIOS filename> /P /B /N /ME
2. Reboot the system
3. Check version in BIOS setup menu and OS

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BIOS should be flashed without errors
2. Version should be shown correctly in BIOS and OS

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes exact image/shell dependency and bricking risk but omits anti-rollback and compatibility specifics.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / IMPROVED; adds downgrade support, anti-rollback, ME/boot/security compatibility and recovery.

original_test_intent: Downgrade System ROM to an explicitly supported previous BIOS using AFUEFI, activate by reboot, and verify that exact previous version in BIOS Setup and OS without flash errors.
original_method: Validate board/image/tool identity, downgrade support, anti-rollback and cross-version BIOS/ME/NVRAM/boot compatibility, stage approved EFI media and recovery, execute the exact region write without interruption, then verify displayed BIOS Setup and OS state.
manual_activity: An engineer must supervise the destructive downgrade/EFI-shell interaction and personally verify the resulting version in BIOS Setup. Agent staging, command assistance, OS/BMC evidence and screenshot analysis cannot replace that core visual acceptance.
required_inputs: Exact board identity, current BIOS/ME/security/settings baseline
Signed/checksummed supported previous image and release notes
Anti-rollback authorization and documented BIOS/ME/boot/NVRAM compatibility
Stable AC, EFI media, recovery image/procedure and BMC/OOB access
safety_requirements: Do not downgrade merely because an image is older and never bypass anti-rollback.
Validate cross-version ME, boot, NVRAM, TPM and Secure Boot compatibility before any write.
Never interrupt power/reboot during write; stop on validation or AFU error and preserve output.
No automatic retry, alternate image/flags, rollback override, blind reboot or recovery flash.
Review configuration deltas after activation because downgrade may reset or invalidate settings.
agent_execution_scope: Validate hashes, support/anti-rollback evidence, compatibility, flags, power and recovery readiness.
Stage exact artifacts and capture AFUEFI/reboot/OS/BMC/BIOS-screen evidence under engineer supervision.
Compare post state and prepare Tool Result without claiming BIOS-menu verification or PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve supported downgrade and supervise EFI flash and activation.
Observe BIOS Setup version/settings and decide compatibility disposition.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It preserves the source command but omits downgrade-specific anti-rollback/compatibility and cannot satisfy BIOS Setup via dmidecode alone.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the exact AFUEFI command only with platform-approved downgrade and region policy; never add an anti-rollback bypass or generic alternate.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Previous-version intent, exact command/flags, reboot, BIOS/OS checks, script and 5/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: SOURCE AFUEFI DOWNGRADE RETAINED WITH ANTI-ROLLBACK AND HUMAN SETUP VERIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed compatibility manifest covering current/target BIOS, ME and security state, enforce anti-rollback, capture uninterrupted flash evidence, and pair OS results with human-confirmed BIOS Setup/version/settings.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only platforms explicitly supporting the chosen previous release and AFUEFI region set.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record AFUEFI/image hashes, board revision, current/target BIOS/ME, anti-rollback state, BMC and EFI environment.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform/AMI downgrade procedure and release documentation supplied with the approved package.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds downgrade-specific support, anti-rollback, compatibility and configuration-delta controls without changing the flash path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An OS-reported old version cannot prove BIOS Setup state or that security/configuration survived correctly.

project_override_considerations: Projects may select a different supported previous release or narrower region set. Evidence must state actual target and regions; it cannot claim the original full region write if changed.
expected_evidence: Board/current state, target support matrix, anti-rollback evidence, tool/image hashes and approval
Exact EFI command, full AFUEFI output/status and stable-power record
Timestamped engineer-confirmed BIOS Setup version and OS version

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, procedure and criteria consistently specify downgrade to a previous version and dual-location verification.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear; missing target/support artifacts are readiness inputs. Human core acceptance is represented by MANUAL ONLY, not BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds anti-rollback, cross-version compatibility and complete dual-location evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains all downgrade-specific safety work but changes classification to MANUAL ONLY because the required BIOS Setup observation is core acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates extensive agent assistance from engineer visual confirmation and formal verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents unsupported 'older is valid' downgrades and prevents dmidecode alone from satisfying the BIOS Setup criterion.
independent_technical_reasoning: Downgrade differs materially from upgrade because anti-rollback and old BIOS/ME/security compatibility can fail even with a valid image. Required EFI/BIOS Setup interaction keeps core acceptance manual under V3.1.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not retry AFUEFI, bypass anti-rollback, change image/flags, reboot after flash error or start recovery without a new engineer-directed plan.
